description_excerpt: At Siemens Mobility , we enable our customers worldwide to realise sustainable mobility solutions. The BIM Manager and Digital Engineering Lead will lead Building Information Modelling and digital engineering activities for the Electrical and Mechanical systems scope of a major railway project in Vietnam.
